code: export function diffManifests(local, remote) { const pull = []; const localOnly = []; const localSet = new Set(Object.keys(local.files)); for (const relpath in remote.files) { const remoteHash = remote.files[relpath]; if (local.files[relpath] !== remoteHash) pull.push(relpath); localSet.delete(relpath); } for (const relpath of localSet) localOnly.push(relpath); return { pull: pull.sort(), localOnly: localOnly.sort() }; }
